description: Searches offers when the user asks for them, filtered by category (one_time, monthly, addon, or hepsi = all), optional city and optional maximum price in TRY. Returns matching offers sorted by sort_by (price | rating | relevance; default price, lowest first) and shows them as cards. No paid or sponsored ranking. Currently returns operator-owned Aegis Scanner plans from aegisscanner.com/landing#pricing.

city.description: City filter (case- and Turkish-diacritic-insensitive). Example: İstanbul, Ankara, İzmir, Bursa

sort_by.description: Sort order: price (lowest first, default), rating (highest first), or relevance (rating then price). No paid placement.

name: search_offers
title: Search offers
